config: prefill-400 build 1a1d1ab, batch/ubatch 4096, 64 decode / 112 prefill threads, MTP cap 1
method: each variant: fresh server restart, health wait, 2 back-to-back runs; all 4 variants measured in one session, back-to-back

conclusion: Back-to-back on an idle machine: Q8 signed ~ +5.4%, Q4/Q5 scaled-K ~ +4.3%, combined ~ +9.9% over kernels-off on this prompt. Individual contributions are additive within measurement noise (~2 tok/s).
